## 🔒 Security and privacy
- [ ] No secrets added; any new one referenced by variable name only
- [ ] Inputs validated at the boundary; failures are loud
- [ ] Network calls, data collection or files kept on the user's machine: none, or listed and documented in PRIVACY.md
